atoms.text:
Act II, Scene I

(Setting: farmers market in the town square. The sun is shining, and the townspeople and Mayor Magnolia are happily walking around the farmer’s market. The market is loud and lots of laughter can be heard.)

Townsperson I: Come get your vegetables! All natural, all local, all fresh! Get your vegetables here!

(Thatcher the Thief, Ted the Tender and Rubellious the Ridiculous enter from stage right. Angry outcries come from the townspeople as they notice the dragons. Some people faint and scream.)

Thatcher the Thief: (yelling) There is nothing to be afraid of! There’s been a terrible mix up.

Townsperson II: (angrily) We don’t want dragons in our town. They’ve been stealing our jewels and killing our sheep!

(Murmurs begin to spread throughout the crowd. Thatcher the Thief tries to calm down the crowd.)

Thatcher the Thief: (raising his voice so everybody can hear him) Listen up everybody! The dragons didn’t steal our jewels!

(In the background, Mayor Magnolia starts to slowly back away, trying to move offstage. Thatcher the Thief notices.)
